name: teach
description: Builds a persistent, personalized study space with short self-contained HTML lessons grounded in verified sources, citations, quizzes, audio and recorded progress.

interface.shortDescription: Continuous personalized study with verified sources and HTML lessons
interface.longDescription: Treats model memory as unreliable, verifies every claim against authoritative sources, records a source ledger with history in RESOURCES.md, writes short self-contained HTML lessons with quizzes and speech audio, and stores goals and progress in the study directory so learning resumes across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Use /teach to start studying a topic with verified sources and short HTML lessons
Continue my study from the saved progress with /teach next
Show my study status with /teach status
